questions.question: Where is a generic method's type parameter declared?
questions.explanation: For example: public static <T> T first(...).

questions.question: Can a non-generic class contain a generic method?
questions.explanation: The method can declare a type parameter with method scope.

questions.question: Why use Comparable<T> as an interface bound?
questions.explanation: The generic algorithm depends on a behavioural contract.

questions.question: Which signature relates an input element type to the returned element?
questions.explanation: A named T links the list element and return types.
